meanings.en: to drive away, move vehicle elsewhere
meanings.note: Prefix 'от-' ('away from, off') marks separation, completion, or response (stem 'огнать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'drove away', paired with 'отгонять'.

examples.text: Костя, всё нормально, я уже отогнал её.
examples.trans: Kostya, everything is fine, I already drove it away.

examples.text: Я пока фургон отгоню.
examples.trans: I will move the van away for now.

examples.text: Водитель отогнал машину в гараж.
examples.trans: The driver moved the car to the garage.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'she; it', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Потому что она останется со мной.
examples.trans: Because she will stay with me.

examples.text: Она доцент.
examples.trans: She's a lecturer.

meanings.note: Prefix 'под-' ('under, up to') indicates approaching or supporting from below (stem 'ождать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'wait', paired with 'ждать'.

examples.trans: You'll do everything calmly.

meanings.en: to take offence, to get upset
meanings.note: Prefix 'об-' ('around, about') marks encirclement or comprehensive action (stem 'ижаться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'take offense / be mad', paired with 'обидеться'.

examples.text: Да не обижайся ты, Ваня.
examples.trans: Don't take offence, Vanya.

examples.text: Не обижайся на мои слова.
examples.trans: Don't be offended by my words.

examples.text: Да не обижайся ты, Ваня. Сейчас найду подходящую одежду.
examples.trans: Don't take offence, Vanya. I'll find suitable clothes right now.
